hero.title: The easiest and funniest way to organize your bingo
hero.subtitle: Control your rounds, share with friends and track in real time, all in the palm of your hand!

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.step1: Download the Bingou! app from Google Play or Apple App Store.
instructions.step2: Create your account with a valid email and password.
instructions.step3: Create or join a bingo session.
instructions.step5: Check the winners and saved history.
instructions.step6: Security tips: never share your password.
